text.text_excerpt: I loved everything about this bed and breakfast Inn. Great hospitality. Beautiful interior. Historical location. Comfort rooms. And my favorite free house made breakfast, fruit, coffee, juice, yogurt, and the most amazing dinning room to sit in and eat at. I was going to book a room at my usual Canal St hotel just to be in the center of everything. The thing about getting a room in that area: no parking. It's free parking at this hotel. Sold!!! It's only one mile to the French Quarter and one walking black to St. Charles Street. Here is the perfect location to stay. I do plan on rebooking here next time a come to New Orleans.

Good friends of mine got married here, they rented out the entire place for a weekend. First thing i notice was parking, you might luck out and park in front or down the street, but if anything is going on around that area you might park a block or two away. My First impression when i walked in the front door was Damn I went back in time, they had all kinds of old New Orleans stuff. Now im sure it was different then it normally looks because it was being set up for a wedding so i will try to keep that in mind when describing. this wonderful - Off the Beaten Path - bed and breakfast? delivers the goods.... priced right, with local flair, a lower garden district mansion, comfy rooms, courtyard to boot, makes a wonderful spot to get married in, have a party, or just enjoy the quiet of the garden district. Located between magazine and st charles, your minutes away from shopping, or bar hopping, restaurants galore. The staff is over the top, and there at every turn, if you need information, maps, or in general, great conversation... they're ready to jump to it. rooms are super luxurious, and the mansion itself, lends an old school charm to your visit. literally just blocks from Lee Circle, and the streetcar line......
